subject: Prompt roundtable: POC working session — inventory, routing, load tests
messages:
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Tim Sanders <tim.sanders@nebulahc.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 13:12:00 -0700
Subject: Prompt roundtable: POC working session — inventory, routing, load tests

Hi Tim —

Thanks again for the call yesterday. Per our agreement, we'd like to schedule the hands-on POC working session focused on three things: prompt inventory & guardrails, routing/structured-output requirements, and a short load test to validate throughput and caching strategies. The session is meant to be collaborative (your engineers + our SEs/ops) so we can lock the concrete runbook.

Proposed format (90 minutes):
- 15 min: intros & POC goals / success criteria
- 30 min: prompt inventory review & guardrail checklist (we'll walk your representative through the template)
- 20 min: structured output / routing requirements and quick sample prompts
- 25 min: live load test plan walkthrough and scheduling (we will NOT run the full blast during this call unless you want a short smoke run)

Scheduling options (please confirm your preferred slot & attendees):
1) Fri, 23 Jul — 10:00–11:30 AM EDT (14:00–15:30 UTC)
2) Mon, 26 Jul — 09:00–10:30 AM PDT (16:00–17:30 UTC)
3) Tue, 27 Jul — 03:00–04:30 PM BST (10:00–11:30 AM PDT)

Attachments: POC_Agenda_PromptRoundtable_v1.pdf, prompt_inventory_template.csv — please fill the prompt inventory with your top ~25 prompts ahead of time if possible; we'll use it as the working doc.

Access notes: if you'd like us to run a brief smoke test against a staging endpoint, please add an SSH/conn or a short-lived API key to the inventory doc (we'll handle keys via your security contact and rotate immediately after).

Next steps: confirm slot + add any additional NebulaHealth engineers (esp. the person who owns prompts and the person who can run traffic).

Thanks — looking forward to it.

— Ava Chen
Solutions Engineer | Redwood Inference
ava.chen@redwood.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
Redwood Inference — production-grade inference for LLMs
From: Tim Sanders <tim.sanders@nebulahc.com>

Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>
Date: Thu, 15 Jul 2026 15:04:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Prompt roundtable: POC working session — inventory, routing, load tests

On Thu, Jul 15, 2026 at 1:12 PM Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai> wrote:
> Thanks again for the call yesterday. Per our agreement, we'd like to schedule the hands-on POC working session focused on three things: prompt inventory & guardrails, routing/structured-output requirements, and a short load test to validate throughput and caching strategies.
> 
> Proposed format (90 minutes): ...

Hi Ava —

This looks great. Option 1 (Fri 23 Jul, 10:00 AM EDT) works best for our team. I'm looping in my colleague Sara Lin (cc'd) who will own the prompt inventory on our side. A couple of asks from us:

- Can the load test be split into a separate window (we prefer not to run traffic during the working session itself) — a short smoke test is fine during the workshop, full load on a separate day.
- We'll need a short list of required environment credentials for the smoke test; Sara will coordinate with our infra.
- Our legal/security team may ask for a brief note on data retention during the test — can someone from Redwood outline that?

Sara and I are available in the 10:00–11:30 slot. If you can send a calendar invite and confirm the post-workshop load-test slot, we can lock it.

Thanks,
Tim
Head of Product Engineering | NebulaHealth
Tim.Sanders@nebulahc.com | +1 (617) 555-0147
From: Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 08:22:00 -0700
Subject: FW: Prompt roundtable: POC working session — ops prep and load-test window

Ben / Monica / Marcus —

Heads-up: Tim confirmed Fri 23 Jul 10:00–11:30 AM EDT for the hands-on. External attendees: Tim Sanders + Sara Lin (NebulaHealth).

Requests from the customer and our runbook items:
- Customer wants the full load test on a separate day. Proposed load-test window: Sat 24 Jul 14:00–15:30 UTC (short burst + 10-min smoke).
- Ben: can you prepare a small routing fallback config and a quantization/latency baseline we can show? Keep the demo on a lightweight model (1.5B) and note the expected token/s on the agenda.
- Marcus: please draft 2 example structured-output schemas we can validate (JSON schema + sample responses). We'll need one for medical-summary and one for billing-extract.
- Monica: ops checklist — ensure we have monitoring hooks + temporary API key rotation procedure. See attached ops-checklist.txt for the initial items.

Attachments: ops-checklist.txt (internal), I'll share the filled prompt_inventory when Nebula sends theirs.

If any of the proposed internal assignments are a problem, flag now; otherwise I'll send the customer calendar invite and include the Drive folder and meeting link.

— Ava
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Tim Sanders <tim.sanders@nebulahc.com>, Ava Chen <ava.chen@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.ai>, Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwood.ai>, Sara Lin <sara.lin@nebulahc.com>
Date: Fri, 16 Jul 2026 09:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Prompt roundtable: POC working session — inventory, routing, load tests

Thanks Ava — schedule confirmed on our side.

Confirming logistics:
- Workshop: Fri, 23 Jul 2026 | 10:00–11:30 AM EDT (meeting link: https://meet.redwood.ai/j/neb-poc-451)
- Load test (separate): Sat, 24 Jul 2026 | 14:00–15:30 UTC — we'll run a controlled burst (target ~200 rps sustained for 5 min, then a 10-min tail). We will not run this until Nebula gives staging creds.

Deliverables pre-work:
- Ava: send calendar invite & attach prompt_inventory_template.csv (done)
- Tim/Sara: fill top ~25 prompts into the template by Tue 20 Jul EOD
- Marcus: structured-output schemas (will upload to Drive by Mon 19 Jul)
- Monica: temporary API key rotation + tracing hooks verified (ops-checklist updated)

Attachments: meeting-invite.ics (calendar invite stub)

Security note for legal: during the load test we will not persist customer tenants in logs beyond the default short retention used for telemetry; specific retention windows and access controls can be documented in an addendum (Ben Carter, cc security@redwood.ai). If Nebula needs formal wording, I'll draft a short statement.

See you all on the 23rd.

— Ben Carter
